crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of…
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
translations.bsb: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.
translations.kjv: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
translations.asv: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Jehovah sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
